subject: Your account number has changed
text:
Dear Customer,

We have completed an upgrade to our billing system. Your service account number has changed from 4471-2209 to 900173344102. Please use your new account number on all future correspondence and when paying your bill.

Our payment address and online payment options remain the same.

Midstate Energy Customer Care
label: ordinary
note: Customer account number at a utility, not a bank account.
